riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people with steady hands, close attention, and a willingness to build long-term relationships. Seeing an established patient move from a painful frown to a smiling follow-up visit makes earned trust one of the career's most tangible rewards.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most dependable reward in this work is a reputation that grows over time. Established patients whose insomnia, neck and shoulder pain, or menstrual symptoms improve often bring relatives and friends. After ten years, many acupuncturists rely mainly on referrals, and experience becomes an advantage.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳心细、愿意跟人长期打交道」的人——看着老病人从疼得皱眉到笑着复诊，这种被信任的感觉是这行最踏实的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「口碑越做越厚」：治好了失眠、肩颈痛、月经不调的老病人，会带家人朋友来，一个针灸师做十年，客户基本靠转介绍，越老越吃香。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 现实型 R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who treat laboratory work as a craft. Every reliable dataset is earned through hands-on skill.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The happiest moment in this field is when an experiment finally works. When a three-month experiment produces its first solid dataset, every restart feels worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把实验当手艺」的人——每一组可靠的数据，都是你手上的功夫换来的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最开心的是「实验终于跑通」——那个做了三个月的实验，出了第一组像样的数据，你会觉得之前所有重来都值了。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine steady hands, endurance, and enjoyment of hands-on work. Walls must be straight and the finish precise.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops productivity through repetition. You need steady hands, accurate eyes, and the physical resilience for outdoor work. It suits practical people who enjoy hands-on work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, routine, and business (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 能吃苦 + 爱动手」凑一块的人——墙要砌直，活要出细。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在重复里出活」——既要手稳眼准，也要吃得了户外与体力。适合踏实、动手强的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实际、常规、企业（实际 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who treat each restoration as a work of art. Every groove and ceramic shade layer under the magnifier carries the technician's signature.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding moment is hearing that a patient is comfortable with the restoration. That brief feedback reflects many hours of precise laboratory work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Artistic A + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把一颗牙当艺术品做」的人——放大镜下的每一个窝沟、每一层瓷色，都是你的签名。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「病人戴上舒服」——牙医说「这个冠戴上去患者很满意」，那一句反馈，是技工室里多少个小时磨出来的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 艺术型 A + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Dentists, General are worth considering if you remain curious about oral health and accept clinical judgment under moderate risk. Use this fit guidance for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.
riasec_fit_block.interest: General dentistry demands steadiness, precision, and care. Dentists need skilled hands and must also help anxious patients relax. It suits people who handle pressure and build trust over time.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S: diagnosing problems, working with the hands, and helping people.

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Dentists, General有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，牙医、普通值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳准细」——既要手不抖，也要让怕疼的人放松。适合手巧、抗压、又愿意长期经营信任的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究诊断、动手操作、也重助人（研究 I + 现实 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits physicians who can interpret both images and people. Skin disease is visible on the face, and so is patient anxiety; Dermatologists must address both. Use this fit guidance for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest satisfaction comes from identifying and treating skin disease. An acne patient returns with clear skin, or pathology confirms an older patient's lesion is benign and the family relaxes. Those moments make the training worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Social S + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「既能看片、又能看人」的医生——皮肤问题写在脸上，患者的不安也写在脸上，两条线都得接住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「把皮肤病看清楚、治好」——痤疮患者复诊时脸上干净了，老年斑切下来是良性的，家属松一口气，这种时候你会觉得这行没白选。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 实际型 R

breadcrumb.label: Drilling And Boring Machine Tool Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine an interest in machinery with attention to detail and a willingness to learn CNC systems. Producing a hole that is exactly right brings tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career builds precision through touch. Operators must read drawings and G-code and use measuring tools steadily. It suits people who enjoy machinery, can stay focused, and appreciate the satisfaction of producing a hole that is exactly right.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱机械 + 细致 + 愿学数控」凑一块的人——孔打出来刚刚好，踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感里的精度」——既要读得懂图纸和 G 代码，也要量具拿得稳。适合爱机械、坐得住、也享受「孔打出来刚刚好」的人，踏实感强。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实干、钻研、也讲条理（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who combine precision, responsibility, and a commitment to frontline healthcare. Clean scopes and accurate assistance help physicians identify disease.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops responsibility through precision. Technicians understand equipment and infection control while staying composed and accurate in procedure rooms. It suits careful, resilient people who want frontline healthcare work and value helping physicians see disease clearly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and helping others (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 负责 + 愿在医疗一线」凑一块的人——镜子干净、配合准，帮医生把病看准。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细致里的责任」——既要懂设备和感染控制，也要在检查间稳得住、配合准。适合细心、抗压、愿在医疗一线的人，也享受「帮医生把病看准」的价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实干、钻研、也助人（现实 R + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career can be satisfying if you enjoy seeing people have fun in a venue you operate. Tourism and leisure are growing fields, and operating experience becomes more valuable over time.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this career is a lively workplace. You work in parks, theaters, or resorts and see guests enjoy the experience. Behind the scenes, safety, scheduling, and complaints make the job demanding as well as rewarding.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「看别人在你运营的场子里开心」，这行会给你很大的满足感；而且文旅是朝阳行业，运营经验会越来越值钱。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力是「工作环境自带欢乐」：你在乐园、剧院、度假村里上班，看游客开心地玩、观众尽兴地散场；但背后要处理的安全、排班、投诉问题也不少，是「甜蜜的辛苦」。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy helping someone move from applicant to team member, this career can be deeply rewarding. One strong hire could shape a team for a year.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this industry lies in the fact that "the more you do, the more you understand people": HR who understand business, people, and systems can influence the company's employment decisions; after AI takes away transactional work, HR who can truly communicate, judge, and understand business will become even more scarce.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你享受「把一个人从简历变成团队一员」的过程，这行会给足你成就感——你招对一个人，可能影响一个团队一年。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「越做越懂人」：懂业务、懂人、懂制度的 HR，能影响公司用人决策；AI 把事务性工作卷走之后，真正能沟通、能判断、懂业务的 HR 反而更稀缺。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Information And Record Clerks, All Other

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This industry is suitable for people who combine "organized + careful + good at treating people" - you can sort out messy information and catch people when they come.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most important thing in this industry is "organization" - classifying messy information into categories so that people can check it at a glance. It is suitable for people who are careful, sit still, and can remain accurate in repetitions. They are also comfortable dealing with both systems and people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers to be organized, rule-oriented, and willing to treat others (Conventional C + Enterprise E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「条理 + 细心 + 会待人」凑一块的人——信息乱你能理顺，人来了你能接住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练的是「条理」——把杂乱的信息分门别类，让人一查就有。适合细心、坐得住、能在重复里保持准确的人，跟系统和人两头应付也自在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿待人（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine logic, an outgoing nature, and resilience under pressure. Problems must be decomposed thoroughly, solutions made persuasive, and data balanced with clients through strong communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to deconstruct problems. Analysts understand business and data while translating recommendations into methods clients will adopt. It suits outgoing, logical people willing to take responsibility for results and enjoy the full process from interview to implementation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising and investigative with conventional interests (Enterprising E + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「逻辑 + 外向 + 抗压强」凑一块的人——问题要拆得透、方案要讲得动，数据和客户要平衡也要会聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「问题里的拆解力」——既要读得懂业务和数据，也要把建议讲成客户肯动的方法。适合外向、逻辑强、又愿意对结果负责的人，也享受从访谈到落地的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好经营与逻辑（企业 E + 调研 I + 秩序 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine practicality, attention to detail, and composure under urgency. Equipment must be repaired reliably and quickly, balancing testing with clinical demands and acting decisively.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops exacting work with precision equipment. Repairers must understand electronics and mechanics and remain error-free under clinical pressure. It suits practical, meticulous people willing to take responsibility for safety who value the satisfaction of restoring a critical machine.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 细心 + 能扛急」凑一块的人——设备要修得稳也要修得快，测试和临床要平衡也要敢下手。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和精密设备较真」——既要懂电子机械，也要有在临床压力下不出错的稳。适合务实、细心、又愿意对安全负责的人，也享受「修好那台」的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、探究、也守序（企业 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people with attentive, steady hands who are exceptionally good with children. Examinations must be accurate, training depends on guidance, and your patience directly affects treatment outcomes.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most moving moment comes when, after a period of training, a child says for the first time that both eyes now form one image. Strabismus correction takes time and parents feel anxious, but each careful examination moves the plan one step in the right direction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「心细手稳、又特别会跟孩子打交道」的人——检查要准，训练要靠引导，你的耐心直接决定治疗效果。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最动人的瞬间，是孩子经过一段时间的训练，第一次说自己「两只眼睛能看成一个了」。斜视矫正周期长，家长焦虑，但你每一次细致的检查，都是把方案往对的方向推一步。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Paper Goods Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine hands-on ability + patience + steadiness. They must understand equipment, maintain accurate dimensions, and remain focused on the production line.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops feel at the machine. Operators must understand equipment and processes, balance speed and yield, and repeatedly adjust for even slight dimensional differences.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, order, and leadership (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 耐心 + 稳」凑一块的人——设备要懂、尺寸要准、还要在产线上坐得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「机器前的手感」——既要懂设备与工艺，也要在速度和良率间找平衡，还愿意为一丝尺寸反复调。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序、也主导（务实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail + steadiness + service. Transactions must be accurate and fast, requiring a balance of rules and customers and the ability to reassure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops accuracy and patience. You must work quickly while remembering rules and reassuring customers. It suits careful, steady people willing to follow procedures.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers conventional and practical work (Conventional C + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 稳重 + 服务」凑一块的人——业务要准也要快，规则和客户要平衡也要会安抚。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「准确和耐心」——既要手脚快，也要把规则记牢、把客户安抚好。适合细致、稳重、愿意守流程的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏常规与务实（常规 C + 务实 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine attention to detail, responsibility, and care for others. Images must be clear and safe, while patients require both protection and reassurance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is steadiness + the ability to care for people. You must understand equipment and radiation safety while reassuring anxious patients and positioning them correctly. It suits careful, responsible people willing to interact with patients.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, investigative, and helping work (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 责任 + 会照顾人」凑一块的人——图要清也要安全，病人要护也要安抚。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳 + 会照顾人」——既要懂设备和辐射安全，也要会安抚紧张的病人、摆对体位。适合细心、有责任感、也愿意接触患者的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、钻研、也助人（现实 R + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine resilience + resistance to seasickness + compliance. The ship must remain stable, rules firm, and work practical.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career depends most on resilience + resistance to seasickness + compliance. Life at sea is enclosed, schedules run in shifts, and emergencies require practiced responses. It suits people who tolerate long separations and isolation and follow maritime safety rules.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on practical work while following rules and collaborating (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「能吃苦 + 抗晕 + 守规」凑一块的人——海要稳、规要硬、活要实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吃「能吃苦 + 抗晕 + 守规矩」。海上封闭、作息轮班、突发要靠平时练出来的反应。适合能离家久、耐受孤独、又守海上安全规矩的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实干、也守规则重协作（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Shoe And Leather Workers And Repairers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who find joy in fixing things. Giving an old pair of shoes new life provides satisfaction that buying a new pair cannot match.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling moment in this field is when the repair is complete. An old shoe with a separated or broken sole becomes wearable again in your hands, and the customer's thanks feels more tangible than any payment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

breadcrumb.label: 制鞋与皮革制品工及修理工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「修好一件东西」当快乐的人——一双旧鞋在你手里重获新生，那种满足感不是买新鞋能比的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的地方在于「修好的那一刻」：一双开胶断底的旧鞋，在你手里重新变得能穿，顾客接过鞋时的那声谢谢，比什么报酬都实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine quick adaptation, clear communication, and conscientiousness. Keeping lessons running matters above all.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most challenging and flexible feature of this work is being ready to plug in immediately. You can teach first grade today and ninth grade tomorrow. It suits people who adapt quickly, command a classroom, and care about uninterrupted lessons.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer helping others, investigation, and expression (Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「适应快 + 表达清 + 较真」凑一块的人——课不断档比啥都重要。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人也最灵活的是「即插即用」——今天带一年级明天带初三，适合适应快、站得住台、又愿意为「课不断档」较真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、钻研、也愿意表达（社会 S + 研究 I + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people with steady hands, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. Standing close to life and coordinating every procedure effectively gives the occupation its weight.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work comes from standing close to life itself. Every smooth procedure depends partly on you. People who care about healthcare, have steady hands, notice details, and handle pressure can find tangible purpose and achievement here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Social S + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳、心细、能扛高压」的人——站在离生命最近的地方，把每一台手术配合好，就是这份职业的分量。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「站在离生命最近的地方」：一台手术能不能顺顺当当，有你的一份。喜欢医疗行业、手稳心细、能扛高压的人，会在这里找到职业的实感与成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 社会型 S + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who consider protecting others a fundamental duty. Seeing passengers leave the station safely tells you the day was worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most grounding part of this career is that your jurisdiction moves and your responsibility moves with it. Helping hundreds of thousands of people reach their destinations safely every day provides a sense of purpose unavailable in office work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「护人平安」当本分的人——看着乘客平安出站，你心里就知道今天值了。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的地方在于「你的辖区在动，你的责任也跟着动」——每天护送成千上万人平安到站，这种存在感是坐办公室给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 事务型 C + 社会型 S
